name: camoufox-sidecar-diagnose
title: Investigate camoufox sidecar browser degradation: add diagnostic logging
description: Add structured diagnostic logging (exception type + message + failure accounting) to the camoufox sidecar to capture the real page.goto failure when the shared browser degrades after hours of uptime. Goal: confirm root cause before deciding on a fix (self-heal vs deterministic recycle). No behavior change to /v1/fetch or /health.
creator: Howard Ju
